Usage: memoriahub backup [options] [command]

Local media backup to a folder on this machine (node-based)

Options:
  -h, --help                 display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]             Initialize a local backup root on this machine
  run [options]              Run an incremental backup sync into the configured
                             backup root
  status [options]           Show backup status: local catalog, running daemon,
                             and server
  verify [options]           Verify the local backup root against the catalog
                             (existence, size, sha256)
  prune [options]            List (and with --yes permanently delete)
                             quarantined backup files
  restore [options]          Restore a backup root back into a MemoriaHub server
  schedule [options] [cron]  Manage the automatic backup schedule (cron is
                             computed server-side)
  set-rate [options]         Set backup throttle knobs (persisted; applied live
                             to a running daemon)
  help [command]             display help for command
